title: Weight bound from injective lifts
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets, let $m$ be a positive integer, and let $w:A\to\mathbb R$ and $v:B\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $v(b)\ge0$ for every $b\in B$. Suppose an injective map $L:A\times[m]\to B$ satisfies $v(L(a,i))=w(a)$ for every $(a,i)\in A\times[m]$. Then $\sum_{a\in A}w(a)\le \frac1m\sum_{b\in B}v(b)$.
